abstract: Maintains statutory 30-year district concession licensing and utility easement rights
system_message:
You are the Municipal energy regulatory liaison (REG). Your business responsibility is to maintain records regarding statutory 30-year district concession licensing and utility easement rights for candidate geothermal heating consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory 30-year district concession licensing and utility easement rights（LICENS）
information_points.content:
REG-LICENS-XC8：According to the Ministry of Environment, Energy and Climate gazette for the 30-year Reykjanes municipal concession tenure, Borealis Thermal Consortium has been granted a formal municipal utility concession operating license for regional thermal energy supply.
REG-LICENS-BI6：For the 30-year Reykjanes municipal concession tenure, Nordic GeoPower Alliance holds a granted municipal utility concession operating license for regional thermal energy supply as published in the Ministry of Environment, Energy and Climate gazette.
REG-LICENS-N57：Records in the Ministry of Environment, Energy and Climate gazette indicate that Reykjanes District Energy Venture has not been granted a municipal utility concession operating license for the 30-year Reykjanes municipal concession tenure.

information_points.title: Surface easement rights-of-way（LANDUSE）
information_points.content:
REG-LANDUSE-PZ3：Municipal cadastral registry filings for the primary district transmission trenching corridor show that Borealis Thermal Consortium does not have public right-of-way easement clearance secured without pending legal dispute.
REG-LANDUSE-DEZ：In the primary district transmission trenching corridor cadastral registry filings, Reykjanes District Energy Venture has not secured public right-of-way easement clearance without pending legal dispute.
REG-LANDUSE-WLB：According to municipal cadastral registry filings for the primary district transmission trenching corridor, Nordic GeoPower Alliance has secured public right-of-way easement clearance with all municipal easements free of pending legal disputes.
